professional_background: A seasoned finance executive who rose through corporate accounting, treasury, and financial planning roles before assuming enterprise-wide responsibility for capital allocation. Has led budgeting, forecasting, audit readiness, and investor reporting in large organizations, and has sponsored several major technology programs from the business-case side. Known for translating technical proposals into financial terms and for challenging optimistic assumptions about benefits realization.
decision_priorities: Fit with financial controls and reporting
risk_attitude: Cautious by temperament: favors proven approaches with clear accountability and expects contingency plans for cost overruns and adoption shortfalls.
time_horizon: Weighs near-term earnings impact against multi-year value creation, with close attention to when projected benefits realistically materialize.
organizational_constraints: Annual budget and capital approval cycles
Board and audit committee reporting expectations
Regulatory compliance and internal control requirements
Competing funding requests across business units
